messages.author: 693e20a67bdbb5c4
messages.subject: Help for Parametrization of Negative Binomial 1 and negative Binomial 2 :)
parts:
I am currently working on my master's thesis, which involves a comparative analysis of Generalized Additive Mixed Models (GAMM) across various software packages, statistical families, and modeling philosophies. A part of my study is focused on the use of the INLA package in R, particularly its implementation of the negative binomial distribution

 

Could anyone provide detailed insights into how the negative binomial distribution is parameterized within INLA? I am particularly interested in understanding whether the parameterization is based on a linear or quadratic mean-variance relationship and the specific formula or algorithm used.

Any additional references to documentation or literature that discuss this aspect would also be greatly appreciated.

Thank you for any help and assistance! 
